EXPTRACK 1.4.0

Install EXPTRACK-1.4.0.apk over your existing app to preserve records. Do not uninstall first.

Update all devices before using Add money. Available balance is money received minus spending dated through today, across all months. Future entries do not affect today's balance. Sign into the same account on app and website for sync. Offline changes upload when the app reconnects or reopens online.

Android 7.0+ and WebView/Chrome 111+ required. Google sign-in needs Google Play services. The daily reminder is around 8:30 PM; allow notifications.
